title: 18-year-old woman jumps off Woodlands HDB ledge as screams are heard, taken unconscious to hospital
text:
Woman jumps off Woodlands HDB ledge, taken to hospital | Stomp Contribute Singapore Seen The New Paper Deep Dive Feel Good Opinion Videos Contests Hall of Fame Stomp 20 Singapore Seen The New Paper Deep Dive Feel Good Opinion Videos Contests Hall of Fame Contribute your story Follow Stomp on:
 18-year-old woman jumps off Woodlands HDB ledge as screams are heard, taken unconscious to hospital
 1/4 View all 4 photos An 18-year-old woman was taken to hospital and apprehended after she jumped off an HDB corridor ledge in Woodlands on Nov 15. 0 Share Cherlynn Ng Published Submitted by Shazzy Read AI summary on Stomp Bites An 18-year-old woman was taken to hospital and apprehended after she jumped off an HDB corridor ledge in Woodlands on Nov 15.
 In response to Stomp’s queries, the police said they received a call for assistance at Block 688E Woodlands Drive 75 at about 8pm. Upon their arrival, the woman was spotted sitting on the ledge .
 “As it was assessed that the woman might pose a danger to herself , officers from the Crisis Negotiation Unit and Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) responded to the incident,” the police added.
 Woman jumps from ledge and lands on safety life pack
 Stomper Shazzy , who was at the scene at around 8.30pm, saw police cordoning off the area and the woman “trying to jump” from the 16th storey — the highest floor of the block.
 She said the Disaster Assistance and Rescue Team (DART) arrived about half an hour later and went to the roof of the building.
 Scroll to continue reading Follow Stomp on WhatsApp and Telegram “Before the DART rappellers could take instructions from the police to save the woman and bring her to safety, she appeared to make a call, then started to push herself forward and jump,” recounted Shazzy, who shared a video of the incident.
 “There was a safety life pack on the ground, but I heard a loud thump and everyone screaming. A man was heard screaming the loudest, but I’m unsure who he was.”
 According to the police, the woman jumped off the ledge at around 9.05pm and landed on the life pack deployed at the foot of the block.
 She was conveyed unconscious to the hospital and was subsequently apprehended under Section 7 of the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) Act .
 “A paramedic was seen trying to perform CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) on the woman,” said Shazzy, adding that the woman was subsequently taken away on a stretcher.
 “I hope she did not have any serious injuries and help is given to her.”
 Stomp has contacted SCDF for more info.
